about: wallfix (r15): what blocks movement, so collision matches what is drawn. solidSprites = the obstacle drawn on a solid TREE or ROCK tile, by zone palette (the same pick the renderer uses: list[floor(tileHash * length)]). They are tall obstacle sprites only, never a ground-clutter sprite that also lies on walkable floor. propCollider = TREE/ROCK tiles block as a circle at the tile centre instead of the whole tile square. The radius is the drawn sprite's cross-section at shin height (0.12 tiles, from data/props3d.json, times its size variant) plus pad, clamped to [min, max]; bySprite overrides one sprite by name. min stays above 0.17 so two solids side by side never leave a gap the hero fits through; max may pass 0.5 for wide bushes and salt drifts that overhang their tile. Walls, lava/water and buildings keep full-tile squares (they are drawn as full tiles). round=false restores the old full-square colliders.
